mapper.select: SELECT journal_header_id, COALESCE(SUM(debit_amount), 0) AS debit_total, COALESCE(SUM(credit_amount), 0) AS credit_total FROM fgc.journal_line WHERE journal_header_id = #{journalHeaderId} GROUP BY journal_header_id

SELECT vw.journal_header_id, vw.journal_no, h.journal_type, vw.status, vw.debit_total, vw.credit_total, vw.difference_amount FROM fgc.vw_journal_imbalance vw JOIN fgc.journal_header h ON h.journal_header_id = vw.journal_header_id WHERE h.validation_run_id = #{validationRunId} ORDER BY vw.journal_header_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fgc.vw_journal_imbalance vw JOIN fgc.journal_header h ON h.journal_header_id = vw.journal_header_id WHERE h.validation_run_id = #{validationRunId}
